# gentest seed 9a6c50431f1e74895501fa9efb877e70657f19878ebbab14730755b94d9bd397
# witness_key2 seed b2078997d35ae5bd202f4ff5a675518e466e8b7e6c01ba48fd8e19097798dc13

# set up log
exec witnessctl add-sigsum-log -key=52c05edad1bf5feffa81354faae59a655d9a9a1a793ed2f62c39c26c0be2aecd

# start ssh-agent
env SSH_AUTH_SOCK=$WORK/s # barely below the max path length
! exec ssh-agent -a $SSH_AUTH_SOCK -D & # ssh-agent always exits 2
waitfor $SSH_AUTH_SOCK
chmod 600 witness_key.pem
exec ssh-add witness_key.pem
chmod 600 witness_key2.pem
exec ssh-add witness_key2.pem

# start litewitness
exec litewitness -listen=localhost:7383 -ssh-agent=$SSH_AUTH_SOCK -name=example.com/witness -key SHA256:8p25WQhnqHBihn+mIjp072aw0WpE9qw7xgW3uRsPSHo -key SHA256:kaKBbFZ2A0eUEe4SOXjuVuh5VEBQlDdIznSf/nEWdH0 &litewitness&
waitfor localhost:7383

# add-checkpoint
exec hurl --very-verbose --test --error-format long add-checkpoint.hurl

# check that litewitness shut down cleanly
killall
wait litewitness
stderr 'shutting down'

# witnessctl list-logs
exec witnessctl list-logs
stdout sigsum.org/v1/tree/985ea163f5af026723561354f51f2ebcdcf2af809ce254ccfb64aa9aadd80f90
stdout "size":1
